definition: Dzmitry Bahdanau is the lead author of the Neural Attention Mechanism paper.
details: Introduced additive attention (Bahdanau attention) for sequence-to-sequence models, overcoming the fixed-length bottleneck in NLP.

explainer.lead: Dzmitry Bahdanau is a researcher. His work spans machine learning.
